company.name: ASYA Feinkost GmbH
company.distributes: Delicatessen, pulses, nuts and snacks, dairy, drinks, tea and coffee and international branded groceries.
company.channels_supplied: Feinkost wholesale to retailers and food businesses in Cologne and the surrounding area.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1998 by Turgay Ilhan and has grown its customer base in Cologne since.
company.fit_rationale: An established Cologne wholesaler at the city wholesale market serving ethnic grocery and delicatessen shops. Snacks are in range but sweets are not confirmed, so treat as a test channel.

company.name: Bos Food GmbH
company.distributes: Gourmet foods including couverture and chocolate products, pastries, pralines and snacks, patisserie, syrups, cheese, truffles and wine.
company.channels_supplied: Upscale and Michelin starred restaurants and professional kitchens in the Rhineland and nationwide, plus an online shop for consumers.
what_they_do_well: Supplies star restaurants and professional kitchens and has traded for over 30 years.
Kept delivering on schedule after a 2018 warehouse fire, with around 200 employees.
company.fit_rationale: A fine food wholesaler 40 km from Cologne with chocolate, praline and syrup categories, where Diablo syrups and spreads could serve pastry kitchens wanting sugar-free options. Its gastronomy focus makes it secondary to retail facing partners.

company.name: Christian Broicher e.K.
company.distributes: Confectionery, gingerbread, snacks, carnival throw sweets, soft drinks, beer, wine and spirits, plus impulse and children's items.
company.channels_supplied: Supermarkets, petrol stations, kiosks, bakeries, small general stores, showmen and event organisers in the Cologne area, delivered by its own fleet.
what_they_do_well: Family firm trading since 1954 in Hürth, led by Max Broicher since 1992.
Delivers with its own vehicle fleet from about 1,200 m2 of warehouse space.
company.fit_rationale: A family-owned confectionery wholesaler on Cologne's doorstep with its own delivery fleet into kiosks, petrol stations and supermarkets, exactly the impulse channel for Diablo bars and sweets. It stocks mainstream brands (Ferrero, Milka, Haribo) but no sugar-free line is shown, and the owner is reachable directly.

company.name: Eurobrands Lebensmittelgroßhandel GmbH & Co. KG
company.distributes: Branded chocolate, sugar confectionery, biscuits, snacks, beverages, sauces, cereals and frozen ice cream and cakes.
company.channels_supplied: Supermarket chains, wholesalers, distributors and small and large independent shops, served from a warehouse in Leverkusen.
what_they_do_well: Carries a deep list of European confectionery brands including Lindt, Guylian, Anthon Berg, Manner and Loacker.
Supplies supermarket chains, wholesalers and independent shops from its own Leverkusen warehouse.
company.fit_rationale: A Cologne based branded food wholesaler whose core is imported European confectionery (Anthon Berg, Guylian, Côte d'Or, Manner, Loacker, Lotus). Diablo would add a sugar-free block to an assortment that has none listed, and it already sells into chains and independents in the region.

company.name: KUBA GmbH
company.distributes: Imported branded beverages and sweets, including Turkish specialties and halal and vegan Trolli confectionery.
company.channels_supplied: Says it supplies points of sale at Edeka, Rewe, Nahkauf, Tegut and petrol stations (Shell, Total, Jet) plus Cologne wholesalers; over 50 partners nationwide.
what_they_do_well: Builds distribution for imported drink brands such as Beypazari, Fruko and Xibe Energy in German retail and forecourts.
company.fit_rationale: A Cologne importer whose model is bringing foreign brands into German grocery and forecourt shelves, which is the route Diablo needs. Its sweets range is still small, so Diablo could become a lead confectionery line; claimed retail access should be verified as it may be store level rather than central listings.

company.name: Maho GmbH
company.distributes: Turkish and Mediterranean foods: dairy, tea and coffee, grains and pulses, ready meals and delicatessen, with confectionery brands such as Sölen and Hitschies listed.
company.channels_supplied: Restaurants and grocery stores across NRW, other wholesalers (imported private labels) and supermarket chain advisory.
what_they_do_well: Has supplied customers for over 20 years from a 3,500 m2 Cologne site with six trucks.
company.fit_rationale: A Cologne importer with 3,500 m2 of space and its own trucks into NRW ethnic grocery, a channel with high diabetes awareness. Confectionery is a minor part of its range, so fit depends on appetite for a new category.

company.name: Monolith West GmbH
company.distributes: Imported Eastern European speciality foods; over 4,000 products in the group's range. Confectionery share not confirmed.
company.channels_supplied: Group's own MIX Markt, Mini MIX Markt and Prima Markt stores plus German grocery retailers.
what_they_do_well: Group operates the MIX Markt chain and reports record sales of 580 million euros.
company.fit_rationale: A large importer next to Cologne with its own Eastern European grocery chain, which could carry Diablo for Russian and Polish speaking shoppers. Its sourcing is East European, so a UK brand is an unusual fit.

company.name: Stern Tobacco GmbH
company.distributes: Beverages, tobacco and vapes, sweets and snacks, spirits and packaging items across 12 product categories.
company.channels_supplied: Over 1,200 business customers in gastronomy, hotels, canteens, care homes, retail and kiosks across Cologne, Düsseldorf, Bonn, Leverkusen and Neuss.
what_they_do_well: Supplies more than 1,200 business customers across the Rhineland with Monday to Saturday delivery.
company.fit_rationale: A Cologne based delivery wholesaler with a dedicated sweets and snacks range and dense coverage of kiosks, canteens and care homes in the Rhineland. Care homes and canteens are natural outlets for no-added-sugar snacks; the name suggests a tobacco origin, so the depth of its confectionery buying should be checked.
